import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ProjectiveLinearFormRatios
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ProjectivePointConverse
import HartshorneLib.Chapter4ProjectivePullbackLinearForms

/-!
# Residue coordinates for projective morphisms

At a closed point of a smooth integral curve over an algebraically closed field,
an arbitrary morphism over the field has normalized coordinates on any standard
chart containing its image. Homogeneous-polynomial evaluation detects precisely
the projective basic opens containing that image.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false
set_option backward.isDefEq.respectTransparency false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace
open AlgebraicGeometry MvPolynomial HomogeneousLocalization

namespace Hartshorne.ProjectivePullback

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra

variable {k : Type u} [Field k] {n : ℕ}

/-- Evaluating a homogeneous polynomial at normalized chart coordinates gives
its degree-zero fraction with the corresponding power of the chart variable. -/
theorem eval_chartCoord_homogeneous (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k) {m : ℕ}
    (hp : p ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k m) :
    ProjectiveCoordinates.eval (ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord (k := k) i) p =
      Away.isLocalizationElem (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) hp := by
  let R := MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k
  let S := Localization.Away (MvPolynomial.X i : R)
  let den : Submonoid.powers (MvPolynomial.X i : R) := ⟨MvPolynomial.X i, 1, pow_one _⟩
  let t : S := Localization.mk 1 den
  let r : Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k) (MvPolynomial.X i) →ₐ[k] S :=
    { toRingHom := algebraMap _ _
      commutes' := by
        intro c
        change (algebraMap k (Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k)
          (MvPolynomial.X i)) c).val = algebraMap k S c
        rw [HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_val,
          ← IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k R S] }
  have hcoord (j : Fin (n + 1)) :
      r (ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord (k := k) i j) =
        t * algebraMap R S (MvPolynomial.X j) := by
    change (ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord (k := k) i j).val = _
    rw [ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord, Away.val_mk]
    simp only [pow_one]
    change Localization.mk (MvPolynomial.X j) den =
      Localization.mk 1 den * algebraMap R S (MvPolynomial.X j)
    simp only [Localization.mk_eq_mk']
    rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one (S := S) (MvPolynomial.X j) den]
    exact mul_comm _ _
  have heval : ProjectiveCoordinates.eval (fun j => algebraMap R S (MvPolynomial.X j)) =
      algebraMap R S := by
    apply MvPolynomial.ringHom_ext
    · intro c
      simp only [ProjectiveCoordinates.eval, MvPolynomial.eval₂Hom_C]
      exact IsScalarTower.algebraMap_apply k R S c
    · intro j
      exact ProjectiveCoordinates.eval_X _ _
  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
  change r (ProjectiveCoordinates.eval (ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord (k := k) i) p) = _
  have hr := congrArg (fun g : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k →+* S => g p)
    (ProjectiveCoordinates.comp_eval r (ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord (k := k) i))
  change r (ProjectiveCoordinates.eval (ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord (k := k) i) p) =
    ProjectiveCoordinates.eval (fun j => r (ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord (k := k) i j)) p at hr
  rw [hr]
  simp_rw [hcoord]
  rw [ProjectiveCoordinates.eval_smul_of_isHomogeneous t _ hp, heval]
  simp only [t, Away.isLocalizationElem, Away.val_mk, pow_one]
  erw [Localization.mk_pow]
  rw [one_pow]
  change Localization.mk 1 (den ^ m) * algebraMap R S p =
    Localization.mk p (den ^ m)
  simp only [Localization.mk_eq_mk']
  rw [IsLocalization.mk'_eq_mul_mk'_one (S := S) p (den ^ m)]
  exact mul_comm _ _

variable [IsAlgClosed k]
variable {X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))} [IsIntegral X.left]
  [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

private def closedPointResidueEquiv (q : NonGenericPoint X) :
    k ≃+* X.left.residueField q.1 := by
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (X.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom)
  letI : Smooth (X.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    SmoothOfRelativeDimension.smooth 1 _
  letI : Module k (X.left.residueField q.1) := X.left.residueFieldOverModule k q.1
  letI := Scheme.residueDeg_finite (K := k) q.2
  letI : Algebra k (X.left.residueField q.1) :=
    (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap k q.1).toAlgebra
  letI : Algebra.IsIntegral k (X.left.residueField q.1) :=
    Algebra.IsIntegral.of_finite k _
  exact RingEquiv.ofBijective (X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap k q.1)
    IsAlgClosed.algebraMap_bijective_of_isIntegral

private def closedPointEvaluation (q : NonGenericPoint X)
    (U : X.left.Opens) (hqU : q.1 ∈ U) : Γ(X.left, U) →+* k :=
  (closedPointResidueEquiv q).symm.toRingHom.comp (X.left.evaluation U q.1 hqU).hom

private theorem closedPointEvaluation_overAlgebraMap (q : NonGenericPoint X)
    (U : X.left.Opens) (hqU : q.1 ∈ U) (c : k) :
    closedPointEvaluation q U hqU (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U c) = c := by
  have hgr : X.left.presheaf.germ ⊤ q.1 trivial =
      X.left.presheaf.map (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op ≫
        X.left.presheaf.germ U q.1 hqU :=
    (X.left.presheaf.germ_res (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)) q.1 hqU).symm
  have hscalar : (X.left.evaluation U q.1 hqU).hom (X.left.overAlgebraMap k U c) =
      X.left.residueOverAlgebraMap k q.1 c := by
    unfold Scheme.residueOverAlgebraMap
    rw [hgr]
    simp only [RingHom.comp_apply, CommRingCat.hom_comp, Scheme.evaluation,
      X.left.overAlgebraMap_apply_res k (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤)).op]
  change (closedPointResidueEquiv q).symm _ = c
  rw [hscalar]
  exact (closedPointResidueEquiv q).symm_apply_apply c

private theorem closedPointEvaluation_ne_zero_iff (q : NonGenericPoint X)
    (U : X.left.Opens) (hqU : q.1 ∈ U) (s : Γ(X.left, U)) :
    closedPointEvaluation q U hqU s ≠ 0 ↔ q.1 ∈ X.left.basicOpen s := by
  change (closedPointResidueEquiv q).symm ((X.left.evaluation U q.1 hqU).hom s) ≠ 0 ↔ _
  rw [map_ne_zero_iff _ (closedPointResidueEquiv q).symm.injective]
  exact X.left.evaluation_ne_zero_iff_mem_basicOpen q.1 hqU s

/-- A morphism over the algebraically closed base field has normalized
residue coordinates at every closed source point. Their homogeneous evaluation
detects all positive-degree projective basic opens. -/
theorem exists_pointCoordinates
    (f : X.left ⟶ projectiveSpace k n)
    (hf : f ≫ projectiveSpaceStructureMap k n = X.hom)
    (q : NonGenericPoint X) (i : Fin (n + 1))
    (hi : f q.1 ∈ ProjectiveTwist.chart (k := k) i) :
    ∃ a : Fin (n + 1) → k, a i = 1 ∧
      ∀ (p : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k) (m : ℕ) (_ : 0 < m)
        (_ : p ∈ homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k m),
        f q.1 ∈ Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k) p ↔
          ProjectiveCoordinates.eval a p ≠ 0 := by
  let U : X.left.Opens := f ⁻¹ᵁ ProjectiveTwist.chart i
  let e : Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k) (MvPolynomial.X i) →+* k :=
    (closedPointEvaluation q U hi).comp
      ((f.appLE (ProjectiveTwist.chart i) U le_rfl).hom.comp
        (Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k)
          (MvPolynomial.X i)).hom)
  have he (c : k) : e (algebraMap k _ c) = c := by
    change closedPointEvaluation q U hi
      ((f.appLE (ProjectiveTwist.chart i) U le_rfl).hom
        ((Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k)
          (MvPolynomial.X i)).hom (algebraMap k _ c))) = c
    erw [ProjectiveTwist.appLE_awayScalar f hf]
    exact closedPointEvaluation_overAlgebraMap q U hi c
  let eAlg : Away (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k) (MvPolynomial.X i) →ₐ[k] k :=
    { toRingHom := e
      commutes' := he }
  let a : Fin (n + 1) → k := fun j => eAlg (ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord i j)
  have hai : a i = 1 := by
    change closedPointEvaluation q U hi
      ((f.appLE (ProjectiveTwist.chart i) U le_rfl).hom
        (ProjectiveTwist.coordinate i i)) = 1
    rw [ProjectiveTwist.coordinate_self, map_one, map_one]
  refine ⟨a, hai, ?_⟩
  intro p m hm hp
  have hev : ProjectiveCoordinates.eval a p =
      e (Away.isLocalizationElem (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) hp) := by
    have h := congrArg (fun g : MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) k →+* k => g p)
      (ProjectiveCoordinates.comp_eval eAlg (ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord (k := k) i))
    change e (ProjectiveCoordinates.eval (ProjectiveCoordinates.chartCoord (k := k) i) p) =
      ProjectiveCoordinates.eval a p at h
    rw [eval_chartCoord_homogeneous i p hp] at h
    exact h.symm
  rw [hev]
  have hnonzero : e
        (Away.isLocalizationElem (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) hp) ≠ 0 ↔
      f q.1 ∈ Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k) p := by
    change closedPointEvaluation q U hi
      ((f.appLE (ProjectiveTwist.chart i) U le_rfl).hom
        ((Proj.awayToSection (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k)
          (MvPolynomial.X i)).hom
            (Away.isLocalizationElem (ProjectiveCoordinates.X_mem_deg_one i) hp))) ≠ 0 ↔ _
    rw [closedPointEvaluation_ne_zero_iff, Scheme.basicOpen_appLE]
    erw [ProjectiveTwist.basicOpen_homogeneousRatio i p hp hm]
    change (f q.1 ∈ ProjectiveTwist.chart i ∧
      f q.1 ∈ ProjectiveTwist.chart i ∧
      f q.1 ∈ Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k) p) ↔ _
    exact (and_iff_right hi).trans (and_iff_right hi)
  exact hnonzero.symm

/-- Distinct images of closed curve points under any morphism over the field
are separated by a projective hyperplane. -/
theorem exists_linearForm_basicOpen_of_map_ne
    (f : X.left ⟶ projectiveSpace k n)
    (hf : f ≫ projectiveSpaceStructureMap k n = X.hom)
    (x y : NonGenericPoint X) (hxy : f x.1 ≠ f y.1) :
    ∃ c : Fin (n + 1) → k,
      f x.1 ∉ Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k)
        (ProjectiveCoordinates.linearForm c) ∧
      f y.1 ∈ Proj.basicOpen (homogeneousSubmodule (Fin (n + 1)) k)
        (ProjectiveCoordinates.linearForm c) := by
  have hxcover : f x.1 ∈ ⨆ i : Fin (n + 1), ProjectiveTwist.chart (k := k) i := by
    rw [ProjectiveTwist.iSup_chart]
    trivial
  have hycover : f y.1 ∈ ⨆ i : Fin (n + 1), ProjectiveTwist.chart (k := k) i := by
    rw [ProjectiveTwist.iSup_chart]
    trivial
  obtain ⟨i, hi⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hxcover
  obtain ⟨j, hj⟩ := Opens.mem_iSup.mp hycover
  obtain ⟨a, hai, ha⟩ := exists_pointCoordinates f hf x i hi
  obtain ⟨b, hbj, hb⟩ := exists_pointCoordinates f hf y j hj
  obtain ⟨c, hca, hcb⟩ :=
    BasePointFreeLocalRatioCover.exists_linearForm_vanishing_of_ne
      (f x.1) (f y.1) a b i j hai hbj ha hb hxy
  refine ⟨c, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ha _ 1 one_pos (ProjectiveCoordinates.linearForm_mem_homogeneousSubmodule c)]
    exact not_not.mpr hca
  · exact (hb _ 1 one_pos
      (ProjectiveCoordinates.linearForm_mem_homogeneousSubmodule c)).mpr hcb

end
end Hartshorne.ProjectivePullback
